summary: No trades. Bankroll $9,981.65 (-0.18%), 303bps behind SPY. All invalidations clear: tilt tracker +0.8bps vs a -600bps trigger, credit calm (HYG/LQD cross-ratio improved 57bps, so LQD's weakness is duration not spread), gross 94.30%, circuit-breaker -1.43% from high-water.
